title: A page from a Tailwind mockup
brief:
A short product update, as a web page. The design comes from a Tailwind mockup: build it with Hyper Elements so it looks as the mockup's classes say.

- Heading "Orbit 3.0 is here", `text-4xl font-bold mb-4`.
- Intro "Faster renders, a new editor and dark mode.", `text-base md:text-lg` (16px on phones, 18px on wider screens).
- Button "Upgrade now" linking to https://orbit.dev/upgrade, `bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white` (#4f46e5, #4338ca on hover).
- Footer "Orbit Labs, 500 Market St, San Francisco", `mt-8`: 32px of space above it.
- White background, content 720px wide, 48px of padding around it.
